notes.text:
This update for pgvector fixes the following issue:

Update to pgvector 0.8.2:

- CVE-2026-3172: Buffer overflow in parallel HNSW index build (bsc#1258945).

Changelog:

 * Fixed Index Searches in EXPLAIN output for Postgres 18
